notes: Platform destination profiles separated from physical rendering profiles. Multiple destinations referencing the same render_profile_id share one physical MP4 artifact whenever their full export fingerprints match, while maintaining independent platform validation and delivery records.

instagram_reels.spec_notes: Targets 1080x1920 30fps H.264/AAC MP4 via shared VERTICAL_1080_1920 render profile. Independent IG safe-zone and duration checks always execute.

youtube_shorts.spec_notes: Shares VERTICAL_1080_1920 render profile when compatible (<=60s classic Short target; YouTube also supports extended Shorts up to 180s). Reassign render_profile_id to VERTICAL_1080_1920_HQ if distinct encoding is ever needed.

facebook_reels.spec_notes: Shares VERTICAL_1080_1920 render profile with Instagram Reels while maintaining independent Facebook validation, safe zones, captions, and delivery records.

youtube_standard.spec_notes: Uses dedicated HORIZONTAL_1920_1080 render profile with non-destructive 9:16->16:9 adaptation (BLURRED_BACKGROUND for gameplay, FIT_WITH_BACKGROUND for ERP tutorials).
